<div class="research-section">
  <h2 class="research-section-heading">Master's Thesis Program</h2>
  <p class="liu-program-desc">
    Since 2013, Linköping University's Department of Science and Technology has been a founding partner of the OpenSpace project. Graduate students in the university's Media Technology and Engineering program complete their master's theses as direct contributions to OpenSpace — implementing new features, integrating scientific datasets, and building tools used by researchers, educators, and planetariums around the world.
  </p>
  <p class="liu-program-desc">
    Each project is carried out in collaboration with one of OpenSpace's partner institutions. Students work alongside researchers and engineers at these sites, gaining hands-on experience developing real scientific visualization software at a global scale. Over 70 students have contributed through this program.
  </p>
  <div class="liu-partners">
    <button class="liu-partner-tag" data-partner="AMNH">American Museum of Natural History (AMNH)</button>
    <button class="liu-partner-tag" data-partner="CCMC">Community Coordinated Modeling Center (CCMC)</button>

    <button class="liu-partner-tag" data-partner="NYU">New York University (NYU)</button>

  </div>

```{=html}
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var active = null;

  function filter(partner) {
    active = partner;

    document.querySelectorAll('.liu-partner-tag').forEach(function (btn) {
      btn.classList.toggle('is-active', btn.dataset.partner === partner);
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.thesis-row').forEach(function (row) {
      row.classList.toggle('thesis-hidden', !!partner && row.dataset.partner !== partner);
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.thesis-year-label').forEach(function (label) {
      var year = label.dataset.year;
      var hasVisible = !!document.querySelector(
        '.thesis-row:not(.thesis-hidden)[data-year="' + year + '"]'
      );
      label.classList.toggle('thesis-hidden', !hasVisible);
    });
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.liu-partner-tag').forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      filter(active === btn.dataset.partner ? null : btn.dataset.partner);
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
